subject: ClearPay: Request to retire prompts/outputs/logs (EU residency) - next steps
messages:
From: Grace Lin <grace.lin@clearpay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: retire all prompt outputs and request logs (EU residency)

Hi Soojin,

We're initiating a data residency-driven retention sunset for a subset of ClearPay accounts hosted in the EU. Per our contract and recent audit notes, we need Redwood to retire all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and the associated request logs for the following tenant IDs: CP-3491, CP-3492.

Can you confirm the standard process and timeline for: 
- identifying and removing prompt/output artifacts (KV cache, request logs, transient storage)
- providing proof of removal (evidence manifest, hash summary, runbook notes)

Please also confirm whether the removal will be performed in-region (EU) and whether any artifacts are retained for backup or analytics after the operation. We need a signed confirmation once the run is complete.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace Lin
Head of Infrastructure Ops, ClearPay
ops@clearpay.com


From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Grace Lin <grace.lin@clearpay.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: retire all prompt outputs and request logs (EU residency)

Marissa / Neha — forwarding ClearPay's request. TL;DR: two tenant IDs need a full retirement of prompts/outputs/logs with EU-only execution and evidence delivery. Proposed mutual action plan below; please confirm feasibility and ETA.

Mutual action plan (draft):
1) Intake: create a support run ticket (SP-12584) and lock the affected model routes.
2) Scope scan: run a quick index to enumerate prompt-output artifacts tied to CP-3491/3492 (KV cache, prefix cache, request logs stored on ephemeral/long-term).
3) Execution window: schedule in-region operations in the EU zone (no cross-region snapshot restores).
4) Sweep: run the KV/metadata sweep, clear prefix caches, delete request log entries, and remove any associated object-store artifacts.
5) Evidence: generate an evidence_manifest.csv, a signed PDF report and a runbook excerpt (timestamps, operator IDs, checksums).
6) Delivery: upload evidence to a customer share and send a signed confirmation.

Attachments I can prepare: runbook_kv_sweep_v2.md (ops runbook), client_confirmation_template.docx, evidence_manifest_template.csv.

Questions:
- Marissa: do you expect any blockers for in-region-only deletion?
- Neha: please confirm final step for DocuSign / signature routing for corporate confirmation.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee

On Fri, Jun 12, 2026 at 10:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Marissa / Neha — forwarding ClearPay's request. TL;DR: two tenant IDs need a full retirement of prompts/outputs/logs with EU-only execution and evidence delivery. Proposed mutual action plan below; please confirm feasibility and ETA.

Thanks Soojin — we'll run this as an in-region operation. Quick notes and ETA: 
- Ticket created: SP-12584 (internal ops queue).
- Scan: will complete within 6 business hours to enumerate objects and estimate token counts.
- Execution window: schedule for Tue 2026-06-15 02:00 - 04:00 UTC (EU maintenance window) to avoid cross-region IO.
- Sweep plan: 1) lock routes, 2) run KV-primary sweep, 3) delete request logs from long-term store (S3 EU bucket), 4) run validation worker to re-index and verify absence.
- Evidence delivery: we'll produce evidence_manifest_template.csv (filled), a signed PDF (clearpay_erase_evidence_20260615.pdf), and an operator activity log snippet.

Attachments: runbook_kv_sweep_v2.md (attached), client_confirmation_template.docx (attached), evidence_manifest_template.csv (attached).

Risks / notes:
- Backups: nightly backups exist for the EU bucket. Our policy is not to delete historical backup snapshots retroactively unless a legal request/storage policy demands it — ClearPay, please confirm if you require snapshot purge as well. If yes, that will extend the ETA and require security/legal signoff.
- Analytics: aggregated analytics derived from the prompts (non-PII) are kept in an aggregated store; we can exclude ClearPay tenant IDs from the analytics snapshot if requested.

Neha — once ops executes, please route the DocuSign confirmation to Grace (signature by Redwood legal). I can provide the filled manifest for signature.

Marissa
Sr. Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference

We completed the in-region retirement for CP-3491 and CP-3492 in the EU maintenance window on Tue 2026-06-15 at 02:37 UTC. Summary of actions performed: 
- Identified and removed KV cache entries (primary + prefix caches) associated with the tenant IDs.
- Deleted request log entries and the associated object-store objects in the EU S3 bucket.
- Ran the validation worker (verified index absence and ran negative sampling checks).

Evidence delivered: 
- clearpay_erase_evidence_20260615.pdf (signed report with operator IDs and checksums) — attached to this thread.
- evidence_manifest_template.csv (filled) — lists object keys removed and SHA256 checksums.
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/clearpay/erase-evidence-20260615 (read-only share).

Notes & follow-ups: 
- Backups/retention: we flagged existing nightly snapshots. If ClearPay requires purge of historical backups, please confirm now; that will need a separate legal/engineering workflow and will add ~5 business days.
- Analytics: we can excise ClearPay identifiers from analytics exports; let us know if you want us to proceed.

Requested next steps: 
1) Grace: please confirm receipt of the evidence package now.
2) If acceptable, we'll route the PDF for signature (DocuSign link provided) and close SP-12584.

Thanks,
